A '''red-bladed''' '''lightsaber''' that belonged to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Zash]] was in use during the era of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She used it during her [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprenticeship]], but later exchanged it in favor of a [[Color/Legends|purple]]-bladed saber. When Zash accepted an [[Darth Nox|apprentice]] of her own, she provided the young [[Sith Inquisitor]] with her old [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="The Old Republic" />
